def safe_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is a plain file name: non-empty, no path separators, not '.' or '..'."""
    ex safe_name("notes.txt") == True
    ex safe_name("../secret") == False
    ex safe_name("a/b") == False
    ex safe_name("") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name:
        return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Return the text of file `name` inside the directory `notes`.

    Only files inside `notes` are read. A missing or unreadable file gives "".
    A name that is not a plain file name never reaches the filesystem and gives "".
    """
    post safe_name(name) or out == ""
    if not safe_name(name):
        return ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return fs.read_text(name) else ""
